tool_action.private_thought: Rejecting his attempt to get NY cheap; keeping NY blocks his Orange snowball. Counter high to (a) make him overpay and slow future building, or (b) make him walk and look blustery. $350 sets a strong anchor and frames price as ‘monopoly leverage’ so I don’t look scared—just rational. If he accepts, I gain a railroad plus a large cash infusion to win auctions/build later while he’s cash-drained.
